_comment: Model manifest for the MediaPipe Face Landmarker asset (DEC-032). Used to refine the chin and eye line of an already-detected face; it does not replace BlazeFace detection, which has better coverage on raw candidate photos (58/60 vs 54/60 measured on the reference set).
name: MediaPipe Face Landmarker
description: 478-point dense face landmarker including refined iris points. Provides an exact chin point (landmark 152) and iris centres, replacing the coarse chin proxy (face box bottom) and eye keypoints that the crop planner would otherwise rely on.
